name: Richard Diamond, Private Detective
description: Richard Diamond, Private Detective is an American detective drama which aired on radio from 1949 to 1953, and on television from 1957 to 1960.

videos.title: The Mickey Farmer Case
videos.overview: Diamond promises a dying gangster that he will take care of the gangster's girlfriend, unaware that the promise will endanger his life.

videos.title: Custody
videos.overview: A woman in the hospital hires Diamond to trail her ex-husband, who she believes has obtained custody of their daughter to use as cover for his shady business practices.

videos.title: Escape from Oak Lane
videos.overview: A man hires Diamond to watch over his frightened wife while he is out of town, but then Diamond is approached by a pair of doctors from a mental institution who claim she is an escaped patient.

videos.title: The Homicide Habit
videos.overview: Diamond sets out to con a recently widowed woman and her lover into believing that he witnessed them kill her late husband so that they could collect the insurance money.

videos.title: Picture of Fear
videos.overview: While on holiday in the mountains Diamond befriends a young woman who is being pursued by thugs who believe that she has taken some incriminating photos.

videos.title: Hit and Run
videos.overview: Diamond finds himself facing off against the mob when is hired by a woman to prove that her fiancee is innocent of killing a man in a hit and run auto accident.

videos.title: The Big Score
videos.overview: Diamond poses as a rich Canadian and infiltrates a gambling racket in order to learn the truth about a businessman's claims that he witnessed a murder.

videos.title: The Chess Player
videos.overview: Diamond is hired by a woman to become a bodyguard to her husband, without him knowing it. He is a businessman who has received several threats against his life which he refuses to take seriously.

videos.title: The Torch Carriers
videos.overview: Diamond unravels a story of unrequited love and revenge while tracking down a fugitive gangster who is in the possession of a valuable stolen necklace.

videos.title: The Pete Rocco Case (a.k.a. Prison Break)
videos.overview: Diamond plays a game of cat and mouse with an escaped convict who bears a grudge against Diamond for bringing him to justice.

videos.title: Venus of Park Avenue
videos.overview: Diamond is hired to verify the authenticity of an ancient Greek statue, which is suspected of being fake when it is offered for sale at a figure far below its true value.

videos.title: The Merry-Go-Round Case
videos.overview: Diamond attempts to convince an old war buddy who has turned to a life of crime to give himself up to the authorities.

videos.title: The Space Society
videos.overview: A man hires Diamond to investigate an outer space society which he suspects is out to bilk his rich uncle since they have talked him into leaving the society $100,000 in his will.

videos.title: The Dark Horse (a.k.a. The Allison Garvey Case)
videos.overview: Diamond is hired to protect a lady politician whose supporters fear she may be kidnapped by the opposition.

videos.title: The Payoff
videos.overview: Diamond is hired to track down a gang of safe crackers and recover the money that they stole.

videos.title: Double Jeopardy
videos.overview: A man convicted of a jewel theft years earlier still claims to be innocent even though the jewels start to show up on the black market as soon as he is released from prison.

videos.title: Arson
videos.overview: Diamond is hired to investigate a fire in a fur shop which killed an accountant who was working there.

videos.title: The Ed Church Case
videos.overview: A veteran journalist and a recovering alcoholic join forces in order to get a story on a protection racket.

videos.title: Chinese Honeymoon (a.k.a. Trouble in Chinatown)
videos.overview: Diamond uncovers a protection racket when he decides to learn why a pair of his Chinese friends unexpectedly call off their upcoming wedding.

videos.title: Rodeo
videos.overview: A cowboy performing in a Madison Square garden rodeo comes to Diamond for help after he discovers his saddle strap cut and suspects that someone is trying to kill him.

videos.title: A Cup of Black Coffee
videos.overview: While taking a break from an all night drive at a roadside cafe, Diamond meets a woman who gives him a look convincing him she is afraid of something.

videos.title: The George Dale Case
videos.overview: Diamond is beaten and rendered unconscious by a man he suspects is an art thief. When he recovers he discovers that a beautiful woman has subdued his attacker.

videos.title: Juvenile Jacket
videos.overview: Diamond is hired by a woman to clear her son of charges of murder, since he is a member of a gang which robbed a liquor store and killed the sales clerk.

videos.title: Pension Plan
videos.overview: A jewelry store owner comes to Diamond for help when one of his employees refuses to return gems he had been assigned to clean unless he is given a large cash stipend.

videos.title: Short Haul
videos.overview: Diamond goes under cover as a truck driver in order to investigate a truck hijacking in which the driver was killed.

videos.title: Another Man's Poison
videos.overview: Diamond sets out to find the man who is trying to kill him and who failed in his last attempt, leaving an innocent bystander dead.

videos.title: The Purple Penguin
videos.overview: Diamond fails in his efforts to protect a shady night club owner who believes that someone is out to kill him.

videos.title: Lost Testament
videos.overview: While investigating the death of an investment counselor, Diamond learns that a letter has recently been stolen from the deceased's attorney.

videos.title: The Percentage Takers
videos.overview: Diamond is hired by a singer who finds himself being threatened by extortionists.

videos.title: Widow's Walk
videos.overview: Diamond and his client are kidnapped by gangsters who threaten to kill both of them unless Diamond reveals the location of valuable paintings from another case.

videos.title: The Bungalow Murder
videos.overview: Diamond is called upon to investigate the murder of a film producer and upon arriving at the scene of the crime learns that the police have not been notified of the man's death.

videos.title: One Foot in the Grave
videos.overview: After a policeman friend of Diamond's is killed while on patrol, Diamond decides to do an investigation of his own to insure that the killer is brought to justice.

videos.title: Snow Queen
videos.overview: Diamond uncovers a narcotics smuggling operation while investigating the murder of an art restorer who was killed in his workshop.

videos.title: The Sport (a.k.a. The Larry Forsythe Case)
videos.overview: Diamond moves to Los Angles where he begins to date Karen after she hires him to find her boyfriend's murderer. A woman hires him to find her playboy son who has gone missing.

videos.title: Pack Rat
videos.overview: An old man dies alone in his shack on the beach and $84,000 is found among his pile of junk. A hopeful heir hires Richard Diamond to find out if the man is his second cousin. Diamond uncovers evidence that the old man was murdered.

videos.title: Body of the Crime
videos.overview: A mobster wanted by the law fears that he is going to be assassinated and asks Diamond to negotiate his surrender to the police.

videos.title: Soft Touch (a.k.a. The Revolution)
videos.overview: A couple from South America hire Diamond to find a political refugee from their country who is hiding in the U.S.

videos.title: Boomerang Bait
videos.overview: An attractive young woman pleads with Diamond to investigate the murder of a fiananceer. Diamond later learns that her father is the police detective assigned to solve the case.

videos.title: Matador Murder (a.k.a. Mexican Art Swindle)
videos.overview: Diamond heads to Mexico in search of a missing art dealer.

videos.title: Murder at the Mansion
videos.overview: Diamond winds up in the middle of a deadly conspiracy when he agrees to help a wealthy young man find his missing bride.

videos.title: Marineland Mystery
videos.overview: An antique dealer hires Diamond to find an Oriental cigarette box and his employee who disappeared while delivering the box.

videos.title: Charity Affair
videos.overview: A masked gunman steals the box office receipts of a charity jazz festival which Diamond is attending.

videos.title: Two for Paradise
videos.overview: After inheriting half of a citrus packing plant, a pair of brothers hire Diamond to investigate a young woman they suspect is a golddigger, who has been romancing their late father's partner.

videos.title: Crown of Silla
videos.overview: An art dealer asks Diamond to make a clandestine investigation into the disappearance of a valuable crown which vanished from a safe on board a yacht.

videos.title: Jukebox
videos.overview: A jukebox operator asks Diamond for help when he is threatened by racketeers who want him to use their records exclusively.

videos.title: Echo of Laughter
videos.overview: Diamond learns that a friend of his, a TV personality, is undergoing marital problems and that his wife may be out to kill him.

videos.title: The Limping Man
videos.overview: A terrified woman calls Diamond for help after her life is threatened, but by the time Diamond arrives to meet with her she has disappeared.

videos.title: The Hideout
videos.overview: A nun asks Diamond to locate a missing young boy who is a member of a Dixieland band she has organized.

videos.title: Rough Cut
videos.overview: Diamond goes undercover as a casino worker in order to find a priceless jewel that has been stolen.

videos.title: Family Affair
videos.overview: Diamond discovers some unpleasant facts about a young woman who was murdered after he talks to her roommate, a dance hall hostess.

videos.title: Design for Murder
videos.overview: An old flame of Diamond's comes to him hoping to hire him to find out who is attempting to blackmail her.

videos.title: The Hoodlum
videos.overview: A racketeer's bookkeeper gets Diamond involved in a blackmail scheme against his boss, when he asks him to find a book and gives him only one hour to do so.

videos.title: Act of Grace
videos.overview: An acquaintance of Diamond's is murdered. At his grave at a potter's field, Diamond sees a wealthy old woman laying flowers at some of the unmarked graves. Diamond tries to find the connection between her and his down-on-his-luck friend.

videos.title: The Bookie
videos.overview: A bookie decides to get rid of Lt. Kile, whose efforts to put a stop to the bookie's operation have begun to annoy him.

videos.title: The Client
videos.overview: A financier hires Diamond to search for his partner who has gone missing in Mexico.

videos.title: The Runaway
videos.overview: While briefly stopping in San Francisco, Diamond finds himself the target of a gunman.

videos.title: No Laughing Matter
videos.overview: Diamond finds himself in a deserted amusement park on the trail of a desperate fugitive murderer.

videos.title: The Messenger
videos.overview: Diamond is hired to deliver a note to a bank teller and is somewhat surprised when the teller screams after she reads the note.

videos.title: The Counselor
videos.overview: A marriage counselor whose life has been threatened hires Diamond to protect him.

videos.title: The Image
videos.overview: An old nemesis of Diamond's on the police force has Diamond arrested on murder charges after the girlfriend of an escaped convict is found murdered.

videos.title: The Adjustor
videos.overview: Diamond receives a tip that a man who has been presumed dead for over a year is still alive.

videos.title: Marked for Murder
videos.overview: Diamond finds himself in a lonely hearts club when he is hired to investigate the confusing circumstances surrounding a robbery and murder.

videos.title: The Caller
videos.overview: Diamond receives a mysterious telephone call which informs him that he will die at a specific time later that evening.

videos.title: One Dead Cat
videos.overview: A night club singer hires Diamond to protect her and her band leader from a disgruntled pianist who once played in their band.

videos.title: Dead to the World
videos.overview: A friend of Sam's wants Diamond to prove that her uncle's death was murder.

videos.title: Seven Swords
videos.overview: Summoned to a theater by a phone call, Diamond watches a magician thrust seven swords into a box containing his assistant.  Is this the dangerous situation he was called to deal with?

videos.title: The Fine Art of Murder
videos.overview: An actress hires Diamond after she learns that a valuable painting which she purchased is a fake.

videos.title: The Popskull
videos.overview: Diamond follows a dog which is pursuing a bedraggled cat.

videos.title: And Whose Little Baby Are You?
videos.overview: After returning to his apartment with a date, Diamond finds an infant abandoned on his couch.

videos.title: Fallen Star
videos.overview: A journalist hires Diamond to look into the death of a singer who fell to her death, which he suspects was a murder but that the police have ruled a suicide.

videos.title: Coat of Arms
videos.overview: A landlady finds one of her tenants dead in his room and shortly afterwards is greeted by a gun-wielding stranger looking for the man.

videos.title: Double Trouble
videos.overview: A diplomat who does not want the police to be involved, asks Diamond to find his missing fiancee.

videos.title: The Lovely Fraud
videos.overview: Shortly after a dancer takes out a large insurance policy on her legs, she gets injured by a hit and run driver and is forced to collect on the policy.

videos.title: Accent on Murder
videos.overview: A woman is killed after hiring Diamond to protect ""a young lady from France"" who turns out to be a poodle.

videos.title: East of Danger
videos.overview: A woman hires Diamond when her father is attacked after he finds heroin hidden in his antique store warehouse.

videos.title: Running Scared
videos.overview: A man is concerned about his daughter, whom he feels has been spending too much time brooding over her husband's death.

videos.title: The Mouse
videos.overview: A French woman gets threats from a supposedly dead war criminal who knows the whereabouts of a fortune in smuggled diamonds.
